title: Restoring the Secondary Trading Market Act
short_title: Restoring the Secondary Trading Market Act
committees: H-Financial Services Committee: Referred To 2026-01-16 -> Markup By 2026-03-04 -> Reported By 2026-03-25
latest_action: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 493.
summary: Restoring the Secondary Trading Market Act This bill prohibits states from banning, limiting, or imposing conditions upon off-exchange secondary trading of securities.  This prohibition applies if the issuer of those securities provides public information on the issuer's financial status in accordance with federal regulations.

journey.note: Reported by committee; waiting for a floor vote
